title: Dad 5: outline 1, like Mom
kaylee: The new Dad gets the same dark outline as Mom, and it now follows his face: no squiggle under his nose, no rims round his eyes, a smooth muzzle.

pictures.title: Mom and Dad 5 in the lab
pictures.caption: Dad's outline goes from 0.35 to 1, Mom's value

pictures.title: His face, front
pictures.caption: The ink no longer squiggles under his nose; the cream muzzle fades into the mint at his chin

pictures.title: His face, turned
pictures.caption: No lines round his eye sockets; his outline and hair lines stay
